apps.description:
Delhi NCR Metro is a Material 3 companion for the Delhi Metro and Noida Metro
networks.

Switch operators, plan trips with least-distance or minimum-interchange
strategies, and follow cross-network journeys that transfer at Sector 52/51
with clear dual-ticket fares. Browse lines and stations, check first and last
trains, follow service alerts, and open the network map with zoom and save.

Features:

* Delhi Metro (DMRC) and Noida Metro (NMRC) catalogs
* Network switcher with local persistence
* Cross-network journey planning at Sector 52/51
* Journey strategies, fares, and transfer walk legs
* Station search with local cache
* Line explorer and station detail
* Network map view with save
* Notifications / service alerts
* Light, dark, and Material You theming

Releases are built with Expo EAS, published on GitHub Releases, and
mirrored into this F-Droid-compatible repository.

apps.description:
Patchwork pulls your tasks out of the places they're scattered across and
puts them in one app.

What it connects to:

* CalDAV tasks from Nextcloud or any CalDAV server, with subtasks, tags,
  priorities, due dates, reminders and Markdown notes
* Nextcloud Deck boards, with drag and drop for cards and columns
* Jira boards with sprints, a backlog and a full issue editor
* GitHub issues across repositories
* More than one GitHub or Jira account at a time

Other features:

* AI import that drafts tasks from a photo of handwritten notes or a
  description. You review every task before it's saved
* Bring your own model: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, DeepSeek, OpenRouter,
  NVIDIA, OpenCode Zen, RelayRoom or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint
* Voice dictation
* Home screen widgets for today and upcoming tasks
* Material You colours, fixed palettes, high contrast and a pure black
  AMOLED mode
* Layouts for tablets and foldables

Credentials and API keys stay on the device in secure storage, and the app
talks to your servers directly.

Slack and Linear integrations are planned.
